name: warranty-mcp
description: Dell, Lenovo and Apple warranty end dates for every client's devices, in one local mirror.

warranty_dell_client_id.title: WARRANTY_DELL_CLIENT_ID
warranty_dell_client_id.description: Optional. Dell TechDirect client ID for the Warranty API (TechDirect, APIs, API Key Management: https://techdirect.dell.com/portal/AboutAPIs.aspx).

warranty_dell_client_secret.title: WARRANTY_DELL_CLIENT_SECRET
warranty_dell_client_secret.description: Optional. Dell TechDirect client secret for the Warranty API.

warranty_lenovo_client_key.title: WARRANTY_LENOVO_CLIENT_KEY
warranty_lenovo_client_key.description: Optional. Lenovo eSupport WebAPI ClientID token, issued through your Lenovo account manager or partner representative (https://supportapi.lenovo.com/documentation/).

warranty_apple_client_id.title: WARRANTY_APPLE_CLIENT_ID
warranty_apple_client_id.description: Optional. Apple Business API account client ID (BUSINESSAPI.uuid), from Settings, API in the customer's Apple Business organization.

warranty_apple_key_id.title: WARRANTY_APPLE_KEY_ID
warranty_apple_key_id.description: Optional. Key ID shown for the Apple Business API account's private key.

warranty_apple_private_key.title: WARRANTY_APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
warranty_apple_private_key.description: Optional. Path to the Apple Business API account's downloaded .pem private key (PEM text also works).

warranty_base_url.title: Dell API base URL
warranty_base_url.description: Optional. Overrides the Dell API root, and your Dell credential is sent to this host. Leave blank to use Dell's production URL.

warranty_token_url.title: Dell OAuth2 token URL
warranty_token_url.description: Optional. Overrides the Dell token endpoint, and your Dell client ID and secret are sent to this host. Leave blank to use Dell's.

warranty_oauth_scope.title: Dell OAuth2 scope
warranty_oauth_scope.description: Optional. Scope sent when minting a Dell token. Leave blank unless Dell told you to set one.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

warranty_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
warranty_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing execute call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

warranty_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
warranty_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.

warranty_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
warranty_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on vendor requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

warranty_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
warranty_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.
